album.title: It all starts with an idea.
album.subtitle: We listen to how you imagine your event before thinking about the flowers.
album.caption: INSPIRATION
album.description: Every project starts with a conversation. We want to understand the style you're looking for, the space where it will happen and the atmosphere you want to create. From that idea we begin designing a proposal made exclusively for your celebration.

album.alt: Floral decoration for a religious ceremony
album.title: Every space speaks to a different solution.
album.subtitle: The proposal is shaped by architecture, lighting and the path through the venue.
album.caption: DESIGN
album.description: We do not design isolated arrangements. We study the venue, the dimensions and the way your guests will experience the event so every floral element feels naturally integrated.

album.alt: Floral arrangement adaptable to different tables or corners
album.title: Each installation evolves until it finds its place.
album.subtitle: We adapt proportions, heights and composition to achieve balance.
album.caption: ADAPTATION
album.description: The same concept can change depending on the hall, the church or the available furniture. We adjust every piece to preserve the design essence without losing functionality or visual harmony.

album.title: The small elements also tell the story.
album.subtitle: Bouquets, accessories and complementary pieces reinforce the event identity.
album.caption: DETAILS
album.description: Details connect every part of the design. From a boutonniere to a bouquet or a floral accessory, we look for a single aesthetic line so the result feels coherent and elegant.

album.alt: Full floral setup for social event
album.title: When everything connects, the event comes alive.
album.subtitle: Each element becomes part of a complete experience.
album.caption: RESULT
album.description: The goal is never to fill a space with flowers, but to create an atmosphere where every detail makes sense. When decor, color and composition work together, the result reflects exactly the emotion you imagined from the start.

process.title: A clear process to arrive calm on the big day.
process.text: We guide you step by step to turn ideas, references and needs into an executable proposal you can quote with confidence.

steps.caption: First contact
steps.title: We start by getting to know you.
steps.subtitle: Before talking about flowers, we want to understand your story.
steps.description: Every event begins with a conversation. We want to know what you are celebrating, who the key people are, how you imagine that day and what emotions you want to convey. We also talk about the venue, guest count and budget to build a proposal that truly makes sense for you.

steps.caption: Proposal design
steps.title: We create a proposal tailored to your event.
steps.subtitle: Every detail has an intention and a reason to be there.
steps.description: We turn all that information into a full floral concept. We select flowers, colors, textures and decorative elements to create a proposal aligned with your style. When needed, we visit the venue to validate measurements, lighting, access points and any technical detail.

steps.caption: Refining the project
steps.title: We perfect every detail with you.
steps.subtitle: We want you to have clarity about everything you will receive.
steps.description: We review the proposal together, answer your questions and make the necessary adjustments until each element reflects what you imagine. You will have clarity about what the project includes, how the elements will be distributed and what will happen during setup.

steps.caption: Behind the scenes
steps.title: We take care of all the preparation.
steps.subtitle: While you keep moving with your event, we make everything happen.
steps.description: We coordinate the flowers, the creation of each arrangement, the materials, logistics, transport and setup crew. Each piece is carefully prepared and we organize the timing so everything arrives in perfect condition.

steps.caption: Event day
steps.title: You enjoy. We handle the rest.
steps.subtitle: Our job is for you to simply live the moment.
steps.description: We arrive early to set up, supervise every space and make sure everything looks exactly as planned. We coordinate the final details before your guests arrive so you can enjoy the day knowing everything is under control.

form.title: Every great celebration starts with a conversation.
form.text: Before talking about flowers, we want to know your story, understand what you imagine and discover what will make your celebration special. From there, we will design a proposal made exclusively for you.

steps.copy: Every great event starts with an idea. Tell us a bit about the celebration you are imagining.
This information helps us understand the size and location of your celebration.

steps.legend: Do you already have a venue?
steps.copy: If you already have a venue, it helps us review logistics and available spaces.
We want to know the spaces you want to decorate so we can start imagining a proposal tailored to you.
Now let's talk about the atmosphere you imagine and how much guidance you need to define it.
If you already have a palette in mind, we will note it here. If not, we can propose one with you.
Tell us how you imagine your event, what atmosphere you want to create or any detail you think is important.
With this information we can prepare a proposal much closer to what you are looking for.
If there is anything else we should know, tell us here.
We are almost done. We just need your details to send your personalized proposal.
